name: @sjawhar/pi-legion
//: test: each command's --timeout is at least twice the slowest row or hook it ran under 8 busy loops on 2 CPUs at 61b66deb or 84270ff (builds Jobs) or on CI; one hook and the rows beside it keep a guard of their own, the last two lines here.

The first, 15000: under the loops the slowest hook, scripts/skill-scenarios/score.test.ts's second beforeAll (the `bun score.ts runs` spawn), took 4,310 ms and 2,690 ms in two whole runs of the package at 84270ff (gf-bun-pi-legion, the same file) and 1,890 ms and 1,990 ms with the file run alone on this branch (d3-score-8); at main 008734b6 it took 5,328 ms and 5,499 ms alone on a six-role INFRA pod (INFRA-2009's tester, 2026-11-19), past Bun's 5 s hook default. rig-isolation.test.ts's beforeAll took 3,408.91 ms and the slowest row 2,100.99 ms at 61b66deb; on CI (the builds farm runs no Docker) no judge-omp row of rig.test.ts but the first took more than 3,342.44 ms (job 126217454413, push run 41722033995) over the 1,341 green jobs the last line names, and the first's time was the judges' image's pull, which that hook now makes. Read again at the round-3 class-search tree (main 46c275dcba with #4437's head e9d8f5075f and its uncommitted fixes), the whole command under the same load (two runs in builds Job d2-c9-pl, 2026-11-19), with main's #4400 row rig-isolation.test.ts's run whose bun cannot read the profile settings among them: the slowest row, a link run's working directory holds the crontab its prompt cites, 2,096.52 ms (2,003.29 ms in the second run, Legion OMP extension > claims/ready failing transiently three times); Bun prints no hook times, so score.test.ts's beforeAll was not read again there.

The second, 300000: a call the abort does not end: the worker ends its own process ..., 117,806.72 ms under the loops (77,259.43 ms on CI). Read again at the round-3 class-search tree (main 46c275dcba with #4437's head e9d8f5075f and its uncommitted fixes) (two runs in builds Job d2-c9-pl, 2026-11-19, the same load): that row, 124,397.30 and 137,291.80 ms, which 300000 holds 2.19 times.

The third, 1215000, runs scripts/skill-scenarios/daemon-pane.test.ts alone: its first row's `go run` compiles the daemon's own functions, which a fresh checkout does on a cold Go build cache, as a builds Job does. Under the same load that row took 381,115.42 ms on a cold cache in builds Job d2-c9-pl (run 1, 2026-11-19; 5,313.71 ms warm in its run 2) and 592,009.53 ms with an empty GOCACHE in builds Job d4-final2 (2026-11-20), the slowest, so the guard is twice that plus 30 s; CI's pi-legion job restores the go-daemon cache before it, so CI runs it warm. It has a command of its own, as pi-envoy's -omp files do, so the other -omp files keep 300000.

rig.test.ts's judge-omp beforeAll, which pulls the judges' image once for the file (rig.sh judge-image), has its own guard, 240000: the first judge-omp row paid for that pull until it moved there, and took 119,329.07 ms in job 134109871047 of #4267's pull-request run 44097039395 (2026-11-17T15:00:12Z), the slowest; over the 1,341 green pi-legion jobs of main's merge-group and push runs, 2026-10-29T12:58Z to 2026-11-17T16:22Z, every one of whose logs GitHub kept, it took at most 15,772.79 ms (job 126587011431, push run 41833651040).

rig.test.ts's judge-omp rows that run a judge (judgeRow) have their own guard too, 90000: each holds its judge's docker run, past this command's 15000 on a loaded dev box; the slowest of five dev-box runs at 70978a40 with no row limit, each started at a 1-minute load of 1,011 to 3,003, was the gateway row at 31,374.69 ms (run 1, load 3,003 to 2,405; INFRA-3904's lanes, 2026-11-17 21:56-22:00Z, logs under /mnt/scratch/sami/TriageBunLoopStall.lJ5iY6/runs/judge-load.aWJXXI/ on the dev box).

scripts.build: bun build extensions/legion.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent --external @oh-my-pi/pi-tui --external @oh-my-pi/pi-utils
scripts.test: bun test --preload ./test/omp-logs.ts --preload @legion/test-fixtures/row-deadline --timeout 15000 --path-ignore-patterns '**/*-omp.test.ts' --path-ignore-patterns '**/daemon-pane.test.ts' && bun test --preload ./test/omp-logs.ts --preload @legion/test-fixtures/row-deadline --timeout 300000 ./extensions/*-omp.test.ts && bun test --preload ./test/omp-logs.ts --preload @legion/test-fixtures/row-deadline --timeout 1215000 ./scripts/skill-scenarios/daemon-pane.test.ts
